bio: Myeon Seoul is Chef Kim Do-yun’s second restaurant following the success of his Yun Seoul. The inspiration came from a stream of customer requests at the original spot for a separate offering of its housemade noodles, which are made exclusively with whole wheat, mung bean, dried pollack, and without chemical additives. For a perfect flavor composition, the chef blends whole wheat varieties sourced from Korea, France and Turkey. Highlights include perilla oil noodles imbued with fresh, nutty flavors; spicy noodles glazed with a piquant sauce; and bracken whole wheat noodles flavored with bracken and perilla seeds. Also recommended is a pairing of traditional Korean alcohol sold as an accompaniment....
